structure.guhs.internetcafe.tooltip: Guhs are asleep behind old beige computers. Walk through the big screen to Guhpixel!
block.guhs.internetcafe_computer.lore: From the Guh Internet Café. It is still loading. It is at 3 percent, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.lobby.knabbel.op_slot: This nibble only shines for those who came through the big screen, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.lobby.knabbel.al: You already had that one, Nyeg! (%1$s of the %2$s found)
gui.guhs.lobby.knabbel.gevonden: Golden nibble found! That is number %1$s of the %2$s. Keep looking, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.lobby.knabbel.alle.chat: All ten golden nibbles found! You now have the title Nibble Sleuth (see your Guhdex). WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.klaar: Ready? Step off the plate and the clock runs, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.vliegen: Flying doesn't count, Nyeg! Just jump. Start again.
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.weg: You left the course. No worries: just start again at the start plate.
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.hulp: No helpers, Nyeg! No potions, pearls or wind charges: just jump.
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.gevallen: Plop! Off the course. No worries: back to the start plate, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.te_lang: Did you fall asleep on the way? Start again, little chonk.
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.sluiproute: No shortcuts, Nyeg! You only have %1$s of the %2$s checkpoints.
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.chat.eerste: Lobby parkour finished in %1$s! Your first time: +%2$s coins. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.chat.record: Lobby parkour in %1$s: a new record! (Your old time was %2$s.)
gui.guhs.lobby.parkour.chat.tijd: Lobby parkour in %1$s. Your record stays %2$s, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.lobby.bord.online.waar: In the lobby: %1$s  ·  in a game: %2$s
gui.guhs.lobby.bord.online.ping: Ping: 9999 ms (the server is having a nap)
gui.guhs.lobby.bord.parkour.eigen_geen: Step on the plate and run! First time: %s coins
gui.guhs.lobby.welkom.op_slot: Hey, how did YOU get here? First you have to walk through the big screen in the Guh Internet Café, Nyeg. Rules are rules!
gui.guhs.lobby.welkom.eerste: WELCOME TO GUHPIXEL, %s! The biggest and chonkiest minigame server of the whole Guhmension. Here: a Network Cable. Use it to make a Guhpixel Gate at home (the recipe is in your recipe book now). Nyeg!
gui.guhs.lobby.welkom.terug: There's %s again! Have fun playing, little chonk. Type /lobby to go home, or walk through the front door on the south side.
gui.guhs.lobby.welkom.wat: Click a guh at a stall to play: every game gives 100 coins the first time. Also: a parkour over the roofs, ten hidden golden nibbles and the shop. Going home? The front door in the south, or type /lobby.
gui.guhs.lobby.welkom.rangen: Your rank depends on all the coins you ever earned: [GUH] from 0, [CHONK] from 250, [CHONK+] from 750, [MVG] from 1250 and [MVG++] from 1750. Spending is fine: your rank stays. MVG? Most Valuable Guh, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.lobby.welkom.kabel.nieuw: Lost it? Nyeg Nyeg Nyeg. Here's a new one. Don't nibble on it again!
gui.guhs.lobby.welkom.kabel.heb_je: You still have one, little chonk! Have a good look in your pockets. One cable per guh, rules are rules.
gui.guhs.lobby.verkoper.roep.1: Now 0% off! While stocks last! (They always last.)
gui.guhs.lobby.verkoper.roep.3: Everything for coins, nothing for nothing. That's how a shop works.
gui.guhs.lobby.verkoper.roep.4: The EULA says this is all fine. I think. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.lobby.verkoper.roep.5: On sale today: everything. For the normal price!
gui.guhs.lobby.verkoper.roep.6: Not happy? Coins gone! Just kidding. No, really.
gui.guhs.lobby.verkoper.roep.7: You win nothing with it, but your house does get chonkier!
gui.guhs.lobby.winkel.kleine_lettertjes: * Cosmetic only. You win nothing with it, except a chonkier house. No returns, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.lobby.winkel.tekort: %s coins short. Play another round, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.lobby.winkel.grap.0: SALE! Everything as pricey as ever
gui.guhs.lobby.winkel.grap.2: Read the EULA? Neither did we, Nyeg
gui.guhs.lobby.winkel.grap.3: No loot boxes. Just boxes. They're empty.
gui.guhs.internetcafe.beheerder.hallo: Welcome to The Slow Connection. Not working? Have you tried turning it off and on again, Nyeg? No? Do that first. Then you may go through the big screen.
gui.guhs.internetcafe.beheerder.terug: Ah, a regular. The screen is still on. Just to be sure: have you tried turning it off and on again, Nyeg?
gui.guhs.internetcafe.beheerder.hoe: See that giant screen in the back? Just walk through it. On the other side is Guhpixel: games, a shop and a lobby full of guhs. After that you can always go there with /lobby.
gui.guhs.internetcafe.beheerder.traag: Slow? It says so on the front, Nyeg. Our connection is so slow that the guhs fall asleep waiting. We call that service.
gui.guhs.internetcafe.beheerder.slapers: They are downloading one picture of a cheese nibble. For three weeks now. It is at 3 percent. Don't wake them: then it starts over.
gui.guhs.internetcafe.beheerder.optie.ho: How do I get to Guhpixel?
gui.guhs.internetcafe.beheerder.optie.tr: The internet is awfully slow here
gui.guhs.internetcafe.beheerder.optie.sl: What are all those sleeping guhs doing?
gui.guhs.internetcafe.slaper.0: Zzz... Nyeg... five more minutes of buffering...
gui.guhs.internetcafe.slaper.3: Zzz... the page is loading... since Tuesday...
gui.guhs.lobby.gids.uitleg: Type /lobby, /hub or /l to go to the lobby (or click your Guhpixel Gate at home). In the lobby, /lobby brings you right back to where you came from.
gui.guhs.lobby.gids.kabeltje.ja: Got it from the Welcome Guh
gui.guhs.lobby.gids.kabeltje.nee: Get it from the Welcome Guh, Nyeg
gui.guhs.lobby.gids.knabbels.tip.0: Tip: have a look BEHIND things. Guhs hide everything behind things.
gui.guhs.lobby.gids.knabbels.tip.1: Tip: some nibbles lie on the roofs. You only get there with the parkour.
gui.guhs.lobby.gids.knabbels.tip.2: Tip: there is a little hatch in the ground, somewhere behind a board. Nyeg.
gui.guhs.titels.hint.lobby_knabbelspeurd: Find all ten golden nibbles in the Guhpixel lobby.
gui.guhs.lobby.chat.regel.6: how do i get out of the lobby
gui.guhs.lobby.chat.regel.9: who's up for Bedwars? i'll defend (asleep)
gui.guhs.lobby.chat.regel.16: how do you make a cobblestone generator
gui.guhs.lobby.chat.regel.20: who did the parkour under a minute? i'm still lying on it
Somewhere in the Guhmension stands a little beige building with a dish on its roof: the &dGuh Internet Café "The Slow Connection"&r. Your Super Compass (tab &dMinigames&r) shows the way. Inside, guhs are asleep behind old computers, and the &fAdmin Guh&r asks whether you have tried turning it off and on again. Nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_binnen.title: Connected!
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_binnen.desc: In the internet café, walk straight through the &dgiant screen&r. Beeeeep krrr... and you are in the lobby of &dGuhpixel&r! From now on &e/lobby&r (or &e/hub&r, or &e/l&r) works everywhere. Talk to the &eWelcome Guh&r: it gives you a &bNetwork Cable&r.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_poort.title: A Gate for Home
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_poort.desc: With the &bNetwork Cable&r from the Welcome Guh you make a &dGuhpixel Gate&r at home: iron, glass, redstone and the cable in the middle. Right-click the little screen and off you go, to the lobby. Lost the cable? The Welcome Guh has another one.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_parkour.title: Rooftop Runner
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_parkour.desc: On the east side of the lobby lies a green &astart plate&r. Step off it and the clock runs: over the AFK Corner, the floating cushions and the roofs of all the stalls to the &ffinish&r on the roof of the shop. Falling doesn't hurt. The first time you get 50 coins.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_knabbels.title: Nibble Sleuth
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_knabbels.desc: &6Ten golden nibbles&r are hidden in the lobby: behind things, on roofs and... under the ground. Right-click them: every nibble is 10 coins. They stay where they are for everyone, so nobody snatches them from under your nose.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_rang_mvg.title: Most Valuable Guh
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_rang_mvg.desc: Your &drank&r stands in front of your name and depends on all the coins you ever earned: &7[GUH]&r, &a[CHONK]&r (250), &b[CHONK+]&r (750), &6[MVG]&r (1250) and &d[MVG++]&r (1750). Become at least &6[MVG]&r. Spending is just fine!
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_winkel.title: Now 0% Off!
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.lobby_winkel.desc: The &dShopkeeper Guh&r has the biggest shop in the lobby, with sale signs everywhere. Buy something there with your &6coins&r: a Guhcade cabinet, a Guh Office, a Guh Cinema... Everything is for home and everything is cosmetic only. Really, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.internetcafe_beheerd: Talk to the &fAdmin Guh&r in the internet café. It knows everything about computers. Well, one thing: have you tried turning it off and on again, nyeg? Meanwhile the guhs behind the computers calmly keep on surfing. In their sleep.
